sources.title: Open Notes Benchmark: Local-first Sync and Conflict Tests
sources.content: We evaluated three note-taking apps on offline CRDT sync latency and markdown portability. Drawback: end-to-end encryption slows full-text indexing on mobile devices, and vendor lock-in remains a caveat for proprietary formats.

sources.title: Independent Markdown Export and Search Latency Review
sources.content: Our lab measured search latency and export fidelity. However, cloud sync reliability had occasional conflict duplicates during offline edits, which is a notable limitation compared to git-backed workflows.
